verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own Conversational Intelligence offering is described as using AI insights to understand calls and improve sales conversations, and its Agentic Voice AI platform claims to analyze customer interactions. Both are directly on-topic, but the support rests on single-line marketing claims, appears tied to add-on products, and gives no detail on what the insights or suggestions actually look like. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on in-product insight and suggestion features, coverage of data beyond calls (messages, meetings, analytics), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
